posts.trend: West Bengal announces government school admission guidelines for 2027; lottery system to continue
posts.context: Having survived college cutoffs and job interviews in their twenties, parents in their early thirties are back to sweating over lucky draws just to get a toddler into school.
posts.angle: School nursery admission is the only lottery in India where winning immediately unlocks ten years of fixed fees.

landing_options.line: Pehli lottery hai jisme jeetne pe bhi paise jaate hain.
Bachche ko ABCD nahi aati, par luck test ho raha hai.
Aapne itni taiyaari khud ke interview ke liye nahi ki thi.
32 saal ke log toddler ke liye dua maang rahe hain.

slides: 32 ki umar mein aapka naya lucky draw: nursery admission.

22 mein: college cutoff ki tension.
26 mein: appraisal ki tension.
30 mein: landlord ki tension.
32 mein: 3 saal ke bachche ka lottery ticket.
Pehli lottery hai jisme jeetne pe bhi paise jaate hain.
posts.caption: Send this to the friend who woke up at 5 AM just to fill out a nursery form.

tweet.setup: Spent my twenties stressed about entrance exams and my thirties stressed about school lotteries.
tweet.punch: It is the only lottery where winning costs you your annual bonus.

posts.rank_verdict: The middle slide repeats 'ki tension' four times like a template, though the lottery-loss punchline is the sharpest in the batch.
